data.body: **[P2] Settle the resumed request before requiring completed telemetry.** The `timeout-retry` lifecycle case returns while the second request still owns the unreleased fault gate. Once its `OTEL_ENTER` is visible, this call requires an `OTEL_EXIT` that cannot arrive until that request finishes; the gate is only released during subsequent fixture teardown. A correctly running retry therefore produces `CollectionError`. Preserve the lifecycle observations, then release and finish the resumed request before checking completed telemetry, with a regression test covering an active retry.
